summary: Example group_vars/frr.yml with network_cli and frr.frr.frr; the user must be in the frrvty group with /bin/vtysh as default shell, plus the usual notes on keys and proxies.
questions: What user setup does FRR need for Ansible?
What group_vars do I need for FRR?
Why does my FRR connection fail with a normal shell user?

answer_card.title: FRR group_vars and user setup
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: frr.frr.frr
ansible_user: frruser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
The `ansible_user` must be in the `frrvty` group and have `/bin/vtysh` as its default shell. Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy line for direct access.
